create.name: Tara Meditation Centre
create.bio:
Tara Meditation Centre is a non-profit Tibetan Buddhist centre in the middle of Bunbury, on Western Australia's south-west coast, affiliated with the FPMT. It started in the homes of two students of Lama Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche, Glenda Lee and May Mills; both later took ordination, May returning to serve the centre as Ven Chodron and Glenda going on to lead an FPMT centre in Mongolia. The centre now occupies its own premises in Clifton Street, and its teachings are led by Venerable Thubten Chokyi, a senior Western nun who previously taught at Vajrayana Institute and Chenrezig Institute.

The weekly timetable joins Buddhism with yoga. Guided meditations on Wednesdays and Sundays introduce simple techniques for calming the mind and easing stress, Venerable Chokyi teaches introductory courses and FPMT's Discovering Buddhism series, and touring geshes visit for longer teachings. During school terms the centre also runs hatha, gentle, yin and men's yoga classes that drop-in students can join. Members receive discounts on teachings, books and yoga, and can borrow from the library.

courses.title: Guided Meditation
courses.description: Weekly guided sessions on Wednesday morning and evening and on Sunday, teaching simple ways to settle the mind and handle stress; the Wednesday morning class adds gentle stretching. Not held in the school holidays.

courses.title: Teachings in Tibetan Buddhism
courses.description: Introductory and intermediate courses with Venerable Chokyi, from Meditation 101 and Buddhism in a Nutshell to FPMT's fourteen-unit Discovering Buddhism programme on the stages of the path.

courses.title: Tara Yoga
courses.description: Term-time drop-in yoga classes for all levels, including hatha, gentle, yin and restorative, and men's yoga, with mats and props provided.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Yearly membership that funds the centre and visiting teachers, giving discounts on teachings, books and yoga classes and use of the library.
courses.price: Single Membership $144 p/a; Family Membership $216 p/a; Concession or Subsequent family member $72 p/a
